definitions.explanation: The hard, pointed mouth part of a bird. Can also be written as {嘴|くちばし} in kanji, though the kana form is more common.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧くちばし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{黄色|きいろ}い→黄色い：00959_kiiroi⟧。
ペリカン⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧くちばし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
⟦{親鳥|おやどり}→親鳥：25490_oyadori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くちばし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ひな⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{餌|えさ}→餌：01886_esa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}んでいた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
examples.english: The parent bird was carrying food to the chick in its beak.

notes:
くちばし comes from ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧ (mouth) + ⟦{端|はし}→端：00936_hashi⟧ (edge/tip). Usually written in kana; the kanji {嘴|くちばし} is rarely used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- くちばし⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: has a long beak
- くちばし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧: to peck with its beak
- くちばし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{餌|えさ}→餌：01886_esa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧: to carry food in its beak

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
くちばし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}む→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧ means to butt into someone else's conversation or business. Equivalent to the English "to stick one's nose in."
- くちばし⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}む→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧な: Don't butt in!

USAGE:
The shape and size of a bird's beak is a key topic in nature documentaries and science education in Japan, so this word appears often in those contexts.
